title: contract-testing-pact input
description: ENFORCED — the engine validates this ASSEMBLED stage input against this schema BEFORE the stage runs (engine/validation.py validate_stage_input; fail-closed, engine/config/runtime-binding.yaml input_validation: enforce). Shape below is the POST-adapter payload delivered at stage contract-tests.

contract_spec.description: Structured contract source of truth from contract-design: {summary, documents[]{kind, context, path}}. Full shape: befe-contract-design schemas/output.json#/properties/contract_spec.

fe_state_binding.description: Structured FE state binding from contract-design. Full shape: befe-contract-design schemas/output.json#/properties/fe_state_binding.

files_generated.description: FLAT-MERGE COLLISION (engine/mapping.py, last-writer-wins): both backend-implement and frontend-implement supply files_generated; frontend-implement is last in YAML order, so THIS FIELD IS THE FRONTEND MANIFEST ONLY. Load both manifests explicitly via upstream_artifacts["backend-implement"] and upstream_artifacts["frontend-implement"].

contract_test_context.description: Optional workflow-supplied runner context: {pact_refs[]{consumer, ref}, provider_ref, environment, broker_profile_ref}. Absent in replay; in live runner mode its absence stops the stage with needs-input — broker/environment identity cannot be safely derived from prose or manifests.

idempotency_key.description: engine-injected: the workflow's single idempotency key, injected into every stage payload.

upstream_artifacts.description: engine-injected: map of producer stage id to its artifact path relative to this stage's dir. Use to load BOTH implementation manifests past the flat-merge collision.

loop_back_feedback.description: engine-injected (conditional): reviewer findings threaded into a re-run after a loop_back.
